summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. 42 deposited phospho RAW files mapped (undeposited MaxQuant-only runs correctly excluded); Lys-C/trypsin eluates and fractions verified against MaxQuant evidence.

reviewer_context.context: fresh-context adversarial reviewer bergen-reviewer-PXD003822-methodopt-phospho-r2; producer report.md and transcript not read; all producer claims re-derived from PRIDE, Europe PMC, live OLS and deposited MaxQuant tables

spec_compliance.evidence: Templates derived independently from the file: comment[sdrf template] = ms-proteomics v1.1.0 + human v1.1.0 (both active in templates.yaml). All required ms-proteomics/human/base columns present; reserved words lowercase; no leading/trailing whitespace; uniform row width; assay names unique; (data file, label) pairs unique; factor value columns after all characteristics/comment columns; biological replicate integer or 'pooled' per TERMS.tsv; pooled sample uses allowed values. characteristics[enrichment process] uses EFO:0010806 label (template example; child of EFO:0009090).

ontology_integrity.evidence: Live OLS: MS:1001910 Orbitrap Elite, MS:1000133 CID, MS:1000291 linear ion trap, MS:1001251 Trypsin, MS:1001309 Lys-C, PRIDE:0000627 DDA, PRIDE:0000561 SCX, MS:1003586 mixed mode chromatography, PRIDE:0000587 IMAC, EFO:0010806 enrichment of phosphorylated protein (child of EFO:0009090): all resolve, labels match, none obsolete. UNIMOD:4/1/35/21/188/259 verified by sdrf-tools check (CLEAN, 0 label mismatches, 0 UNIMOD swaps). Arg6/Lys8 = Label:13C(6) R / Label:13C(6)15N(2) K match MaxQuant Labels1 'Arg6;Lys8'. Obsolete PRIDE-record CL:0000055 correctly not used.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE item 3: super-SILAC phosphopeptide enrichment comparing IMAC, SIMAC and MOAC, all FASP, in replicates (42 raw files), with the note that some raw files in the result files were not used. MaxQuant SS-Phospho summary.txt lists 72 raw files; the 42 deposited ones are the 2nd_rep/3rd_rep experiments (DD/SD x IMAC/SIMAC/TiO2), the 30 others (D6D7_*, D8D12_*, D9D10_*, S3S4_*, S8S9_*, *_4H/_2H/_3H) are not deposited and correctly absent. Phospho (STY) variable for all. Per-run C-terminal residue statistics recomputed independently from deposited MaxQuant evidence.txt (unique non-decoy, non-contaminant sequences per raw file): Lys-C eluates (*_ddig_Lys*, DD_L_*) 92-97% K-terminal, 1.5-5% R-terminal, 30-56% internal uncleaved R; trypsin eluates (*_ddig_Trp, DD_T_*) 60-71% R-terminal with <1-8% internal K; single digests 40-51% R-terminal with low internal R; IsD-U double vs single digests show K-terminal share 59.5-60.7% vs 49.4-50.8% and internal K 13-15% vs 31-33%, consistent with added Lys-C; IsD-G runs are named Ddig/DD by the authors' MaxQuant experiments (IsD_G_LFQ_DD_*, IsD-G_SILAC_*_Ddig_*). Phospho runs: DD_L_* 91.7-95.5% K-terminal = Lys-C; DD_T_* 60-71% R-terminal = Trypsin; SD_* 41-51% R-terminal = Trypsin. SDRF matches for every row.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE /files (168 entries, every projectAccessions == PXD003822): 163 RAW + 5 SEARCH zips. Across the six sibling SDRFs all 163 RAW files are claimed exactly once (no duplicates, no unclaimed, no names absent from PRIDE). 42 SDRF data files = 42 PRIDE RAW files of item 3 = MaxQuant 2nd_rep/3rd_rep raw files; each with one SILAC light and one SILAC heavy row.

design_consistency.evidence: 6 workflows (DD/SD x IMAC/SIMAC/TiO2) x 2 replicates (MaxQuant 2nd_rep -> 1, 3rd_rep -> 2); 12 heavy spike-in technical replicates = 12 experiments. Fraction identifiers reproduce MaxQuant fraction order within each experiment (e.g. DD IMAC L/L_FT/T/T_FT = 61-64 -> 1-4; DD SIMAC L/L_FT/L_MULTIP/T/T_FT/T_MULTIP = 81-86 -> 1-6). Second cleavage column is not applicable throughout (no in-solution double digests in this set).

omission_safety.evidence: Organism part, cell type, age, sex = not available: PRIDE record and abstract give no per-patient tissue/demographic data (abstract: 'cell lysates from patients with AML'); ancestry/developmental stage omitted rather than guessed; no precursor tolerance invented; disease AML (MONDO:0018874) stated by title/abstract; instrument/CID/35 NCE/ion-trap MS2 confirmed in RAW headers (method text 'Orbitrap Elite MS', 'Activation Type: CID', 'Normalized Coll. Energy: 35.0', ITMS MS/MS); fragment tolerance 0.6 Da = parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (ITMS) 0.6 Da'; fixed Carbamidomethyl (C), variable Acetyl (Protein N-term)/Oxidation (M) from parameters/summary. Enrichment annotated at the generic EFO:0010806 level with the specific method in the factor value; no enrichment chemistry details invented.

findings.location: rows for *_FT* data files (SIMAC/TiO2 flow-through), characteristics[enrichment process]
findings.message: Flow-through runs carry the same enrichment annotation as eluates; the eluate/flow-through/multi-phospho distinction is encoded only via file name and fraction identifier.
findings.evidence: Deposited evidence.txt: SIMAC/TiO2 flow-through runs contain 1.5-7.5% phosphopeptide evidence (e.g. DD_L_SIMAC_FT 1.5%, SD_TIO2_FT 2.0%) versus 74-98% for IMAC and MULTIP eluates. Correction criterion (optional): add a comment column (e.g. comment[fraction description]) distinguishing eluate, flow-through and multi-phospho fractions.

findings.message: Deposited content suggests these two files may be swapped by the depositor; the SDRF correctly follows deposited names and MaxQuant fractions 95/96.
findings.evidence: DD_T_SIMAC_FT_2: 650 sequences, 84.8% phospho (like MULTIP runs); DD_T_SIMAC_MULTIP_2: 1942 sequences, 15.5% phospho (like FT runs); replicate 1 shows the expected pattern (FT 5.8%, MULTIP 90.7%). No author evidence to override names; at most add a note.

findings.message: Generic 'enrichment of phosphorylated protein' is used, although more specific PRIDE terms exist for IMAC (PRIDE:0000587) and TiO2 (PRIDE:0000588); the sibling freshfrozen-phospho SDRF uses IMAC.
findings.evidence: Live OLS: PRIDE:0000587 IMAC and PRIDE:0000588 TIO2 under EFO:0009090; no SIMAC term. Less specific is safe; optional refinement for IMAC/TiO2 rows.

findings.location: comment[cleavage agent details] rows for trypsin-eluate files (*_ddig_Trp / DD_T_*)
findings.message: Trypsin-eluate runs of the consecutive FASP double digestion are annotated with Trypsin only, although the material was pre-digested with Lys-C before the trypsin step.
findings.evidence: Trypsin eluates show 60-71% R-terminal peptides and <1-8% internal K (Lys sites already cut), consistent with Lys-C then trypsin; trypsin specificity [KR] still covers all termini, so reanalysis is unaffected. Correction criterion (optional): add Lys-C as a second cleavage agent for trypsin-eluate rows, or document the sequential scheme.

findings.message: Factor value has no mirroring characteristics/comment column.
findings.evidence: README 'Factor Values' rule: the factor value 'typically mirrors a characteristics column value' (SHOULD-level); sdrf-tools score Design 75/100 for this reason. Correction criterion: optionally add a matching characteristics/comment column (e.g. comment[sample preparation protocol]).

findings.message: Recommended column comment[precursor mass tolerance] is absent.
findings.evidence: MaxQuant 1.5.2.8 parameters.txt in the deposited search zip does not record the main-search precursor tolerance; omission is safer than guessing. sdrf-tools score lists it as a missing recommended column.
